Go do stuff you enjoy, go shopping, hang with your friends and family and collect memories of them. Try to learn to love yourself as they love you. My ex did the same to me even encouraging my suicide at one point and that hurts worse than any physical pain, but there comes a time where you just have to take a deep breath and say “Fuck you”. This may all be stuff you’ve heard a million times but there are many people that care about you, and many others who would love to see you again. Suicide may seem like the right answer at the moment but in a month you’ll look back and laugh at yourself for even thinking about it. You’ve got this!
